rules.description: At least five payload-bearing OpenFlow transport segments; learning and FlowMod installation require correlated evidence.
Data-network frames excluding OpenFlow transport; confirm endpoint roles and learned entries separately.

manual_checks: Correlate host MAC addresses, switch ports, PacketIn events and installed flow entries. Control traffic alone cannot establish forwarding.
R1 R2: Identify PacketIn/FlowMod messages and inspect learned MAC-to-port entries.
R3: Show initial broadcast resolution, subsequent unicast forwarding and flow-table counters.
